claims.pass_condition: A tracked neutral schema and runtime contract agree exactly on axm.production-step-receipt/v1 and reject undeclared fields or an alternate schema.
claims.primary_surface: Parsed JSON schema plus runtime contract assertions
claims.counterevidence: The file is absent, fails JSON parsing, disagrees with the runtime constant, or accepts an undeclared receipt shape.
claims.observed_evidence: The schema parses, discovery binds its identifier to the runtime constant, emitted receipts pass the exact runtime contract, and a validly resealed undeclared field is rejected.

claims.pass_condition: Every receipt in a new portable fixture or documentation ledger uses the neutral schema, and state plus terminal receipt disclose the same schema.
claims.primary_surface: Core portable runs with complete ledger inspection
claims.counterevidence: Any new portable ledger line is game-scoped or the state and terminal declarations disagree with the ledger.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Independent CLI process runs and on-disk ledger inspection
claims.observed_evidence: Both in-process core runs and separate CLI processes emitted only neutral portable receipts and matching state and terminal declarations.

claims.pass_condition: An interrupted neutral run resumes without duplicate or mixed receipts, while a resealed game-schema substitution is refused.
claims.primary_surface: Stop, persist, resume, and compare the neutral ledger
claims.counterevidence: Resume duplicates a receipt, appends another schema, accepts a schema substitution, or loses verified output binding.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Adversarial schema mutation with a recomputed canonical digest
claims.observed_evidence: Interrupted resume completed with one neutral schema throughout; validly resealed ledger and terminal game-schema substitutions were both rejected before continuation.

claims.pass_condition: A pre-upgrade interrupted portable ledger resumes using only its original game schema and preserves exact terminal resume identity.
claims.primary_surface: Pre-upgrade state fixture followed by two fresh resume calls
claims.counterevidence: The old run becomes unreadable, neutral receipts are mixed into it, or terminal receipt identity drifts.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: On-disk inspection of every legacy ledger line and compatibility marker
claims.observed_evidence: The simulated pre-upgrade run completed with only game receipts, disclosed legacy continuation internally, preserved its prior external shape, and resumed terminally with the same digest.

claims.pass_condition: The original game entry point continues to emit axm.game-step-receipt/v1 and declares that schema in its terminal receipt.
claims.counterevidence: The game ledger silently changes schema or its terminal declaration disagrees.
claims.observed_evidence: All five game receipts remained game-scoped and the terminal game receipt declared the same schema.

claims.pass_condition: A pinned independent Draft 2020-12 implementation validates the schema document and representative receipts.
claims.counterevidence: The schema is invalid Draft 2020-12 or a representative receipt fails standards validation.
claims.observed_evidence: JSON parsing and the local exact contract pass; no pinned independent standards validator was available in this slice.
